messages:
Anya: FYI 44 Marigold wants a performance-run tomorrow 08:30 PT. Goal: realistic mixed workload to validate latency SLAs before contract. Target sustained 1200 qps, 45m soak. Mix: 40% chat (avg ctx 1024 tokens), 60% embeddings (batch-embed calls). SLA ask: chat p95 < 150ms, p99 < 400ms. They also want audit logs + envelope encryption (KMS) for embeddings. Need run plan, ops config, and a quick cost delta. Can @Priya lead infra and @Tom own harness?

Priya: We should use Dedicated pool in us-west-2 with pinned capacity. For 1200 sustained with that context size we'll likely need 6-8 GPU-equivalents depending on quant. Also recommend enabling inter-request batching for embeds to reduce per-call overhead.

Tom: I can run the harness. Proposed phases: smoke (3m @100 qps), stepped ramp (20m to 1200), soak (45m @1200), cooldown (5m). Capture p50/p95/p99 per-phase, CPU/GPU counters, KV cache hit rates, and API gateway latency. I'll push results to the POC dashboard and attach flamegraphs. Load config snippet below: 
```json
{
  "target_qps":1200,
  "phases": ["smoke", "ramp", "soak"],
  "ramp_minutes":20,
  "soak_minutes":45,
  "mix": [{"type":"chat", "pct":40, "ctx_tokens":1024},{"type":"embed", "pct":60, "batch_size":16}],
  "metrics": ["p50","p95","p99","cpu_gpu_util","kv_hit_rate"]
}
```

Rui: Security note: KMS envelope unwrap for each embedding batch costs ~6-15ms depending on HSM and network RTT. Recommend either local key cache or our KMS-proxy with TTL 30s during the run. Also confirm whether Marigold requires CMK in their tenant or are we allowed to use Redwood-managed CMK for the POC. Need signed KMS addendum before we request keys.

Carlos: Ops tuning I suggest: model_batch_size=12 for chat generation, token_budget_ms=150, embed_batching_enabled=true, embed_batch_max=32, kv_cache_ttl=8h. Set autoscale min nodes to cover 80% of expected qps to avoid cold churn. Routing fallback: if queue growth > 250ms or p95 breaches, route embeds to a cheaper quantized embed model and spill chat to lower-latency variant.

Anya: Great. @Tom schedule for 08:30 PT tomorrow and label run "marigold-poc-1799998881". @Carlos and @Priya please provide the ops config file by EOD. @Rui can you draft the KMS checklist we send the customer? Kelsey (cc) will do cost afterwards but not on thread.

bench-bot: Run created by Tom  id: br-1799998881, start_time: 2026-05-12T15:30:00Z, phases: smoke/ramp/soak/cooldown.

Tom: Harness queued and smoke script tested. Will enable tracing headers and will collect span-level traces. Posting results (summary + attachments) in a follow-up thread.

Priya: I'll provision Dedicated pool with reserved nodes and make sure KMS-proxy is deployed into the POC network (no internet egress required).

Rui: KMS checklist (short): 1) CMK ownership confirm, 2) signed KMS addendum, 3) endpoint allowlist, 4) KMS-proxy creds, 5) test unwrap token. Will DM legal for the addendum template.

Anya: Perfect. Quick reminders: keep run under customer NDA, capture anonymized logs for public benchmarks, and mark any policy blockers. Thanks team :thumbsup:
